bio.text: Breanne Davis, a Republican from Russellville, represents Arkansas Senate District 25, which includes parts of Conway and Pope counties.
She won a special election in 2018 and served as Senate Majority Whip in the 95th General Assembly (2025).
Davis has served on the Russellville School Board, including as its president.
She graduated from Russellville High School and has a bachelor's degree in speech communications from Arkansas Tech.
